div.div: 1. The client reads its settings at /info. 2. It attaches to its AS, at the endhost API and the SNAP, with auth_token. 3. It sends HTTP/3 over SCION to base_url, at the address target, and trusts the certificate ca_path.

switch.text: 1. The client reads its settings at /info. 2. It attaches to its AS, at the endhost API and the SNAP, with auth_token. 3. It sends HTTP/3 over SCION to base_url, at the address target, and trusts the certificate ca_path.
